items.title: Microsoft Unveils Always-On AI Agent Scout to Integrate With Teams, Outlook, and More
items.description: Microsoft has officially introduced Microsoft Scout, its first-ever “Autopilot” AI agent, a persistent, always-on autonomous assistant designed to operate continuously across Microsoft 365 apps without waiting to be prompted. Unveiled at Microsoft Build 2026 on June 2, Scout represents a fundamental shift in how AI integrates into enterprise workflows. Microsoft is launching a new category […]…
